name: ihris-admin-course
title: iHRIS Administrator - Level I (Moodle course, 2011)
description: The e-learning course 'iHRIS Administrator - Level I' (shortname 'iHRIS Admin 1'), made for IntraHealth International's CapacityPlus project and run on the HRH Global Resource Center (hrhresourcecenter.org/elearning), from a Moodle 1.9.9 course backup taken 2012-08-12. Ingested under CC BY 4.0, as its author stated: 6 sections, 80 modules in course order (27 lessons with 334 pages, 27 forums, 21 resources, 2 quizzes with their questions and answers, a glossary, a certificate and a questionnaire), the lesson images and the six transcripts, with an inventory of all 124 files in the backup. The slide audio is inventoried, not committed.

upstream.status: a Moodle course backup uploaded by the owner to litlfred/ihris main (commit 2e24ff22), 2026-10-09; the e-learning site is not known to be online

licence.basis: Stated by the course's author, the folio owner (litlfred), in the building session on 2026-10-09: 'i authored moodle content. it is under CC license', and, asked which, 'CC BY 4.0'. The backup itself states no licence (moodle.xml, the transcripts and the media files were checked). The owner authored the course for IntraHealth International (CapacityPlus) and directed attribution to IntraHealth ('attribution to INtrahealth as with logo and such', 2026-10-09).
licence.attribution: iHRIS Administrator – Level I, © IntraHealth International. Licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Originally offered at http://www.hrhresourcecenter.org/elearning (CapacityPlus).
excludes: the slide audio (40 mp3 files, 16331591 bytes): inventoried by path, size and sha256, not committed because of its size
the transcripts as Word files: their text is extracted to Markdown and committed; the .doc files stay in uploads/
the certificate's settings, which name a contact e-mail address; any e-mail address in the text is removed
user data: the backup holds none (USERS none, USERINFO false), so there are no posts, attempts or responses

assets.title: iHRIS Administrator - Level I (Moodle course)
assets.description: What the backup is, its licence and attribution, and what is and is not committed.

directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated by src/tools/ingest_moodle_course.py from the verified backup in uploads/ihris-admin-course/.
directories.description: course.json (ihris-moodle-course/v1: course, backup, licence, sections, modules, lesson page titles, resource links, question counts, images, transcripts, file inventory), course.md (the outline with the section summaries), sections/ (section summaries), modules/ (one Markdown file per module with content: lesson pages, html resources, quiz and questionnaire questions, introductions), transcripts/ (the six transcripts' text), images/ (the course's images) and manifest.jsonld.
